Energy Vampirism

Nos-4-A2 (Buzz Lightyear of Star Command) is a deadly energy leech who can convert robotics and energy channels to his mechamorphic whim.

Power/Ability to:

Feed on energy.

The power to drain, eat, suck, feed on energy from other living beings. Variation of Vampiric Draining.

Also Called[]

  • Vital energy consumption
  • Vital energy draining

Capabilities[]

Users can feed on vital energy and use it to strengthen or heal themselves, or simply for sustenance.

Applications[]

  • Capacitor
  • Energy Detection
  • Energy Drain
  • Energy Metabolization
  • Remote Energy Absorption
  • Energy Healing
  • Life-Force Transferal

Variations[]

  • Neuronal Vampirism
  • Psi Vampirism

Associations[]

  • Bio-Energy Manipulation
  • Empathic Conversion
  • Energy Manipulation
  • Infectious Energy Manipulation
  • Ionic Radiation Manipulation
  • Parasitic Empowerment
  • Parasitic Energy Manipulation
  • Psionic Drain
  • Psychic Energy Absorption
  • Vampire Physiology

Limitations[]

  • May need to feed on vital energy in order to live.
  • Likely vulnerable to Energy Absorption.
  • As one feeds and grows in power, may cause an equivalent growth in hunger.
